footprint_change.interpretation: F1-F7 footprints grow by exactly the tower rectangle; every other part of the 09-25 shell is identical.

window_retention_vs_0916.interpretation: Every candidate_04 window keeps identical vertices; owner space changes are expected re-hosting.

partitions_on_piers.interpretation: Inferred partitions meet the facade in window piers; no observed window is crossed.

continuous_spaces.interpretation: Only bottom/top horizontal boundaries: no intermediate slabs inside stair/core volumes.

roof_interfaces.interpretation: Roof-volume contacts must be open on both source sides and absent from physical display parts; exposed roof outside those contacts remains physical. Main-storey-to-roof contacts remain the explicitly inferred physical slab.

reachability.interpretation: Declared, partly inferred door/open-contact graph; not real-plan evidence.

tower.interpretation: Position, width and full height follow the measured crop remnants; depth is constrained to [2.38, 2.9] m east edge; lift use and windowless exterior faces are inference, recorded as such.

dimensions.rule: every usable space has a part at least 2.4 m wide (corridors 2.0 m); narrower alcoves are listed, not failed
dimensions.exemption: The tower is a shaft volume, not an occupied room; the 2.4 m room-width rule does not apply to it.

browser_tower_view.note: Camera aimed at the courtyard tower; screenshots are for human review, not an automatic visual verdict.
